project.name: Gully Legends Prague
project.purpose: Gaming/comic styled cricket website and companion APK workflow for the Gully Legends Prague cricket group.
project.styling: Tailwind CSS plus custom CSS in app/globals.css
project.backend: Supabase Auth, Postgres RLS, RPCs, and Storage
project.status: Stable on website main; APK v1.4.0 released/tagged in its own repository.

website.originMainHead: e9db399 Add Best Batting Average to Hall of Legends

apkRelease.upgradeCompatibility: Same applicationId, same production signer, versionCode 7 greater than v1.3.0 versionCode 6; should install over v1.3.0 without uninstall.

authorityModel.rule: APK is recorder/setup client; website/Admin finalisation is authoritative.

xpSystemV2.monthlyBeasts: V2 uses raw category performance points before career category/overall caps and excludes Played, Win and POM.
xpSystemV2.pomRecommendation: V2 recommendation uses uncapped pre-POM performance. Admin remains authoritative.
xpSystemV2.historicalRule: Historical V1 XP and crowns were not recalculated.

userBehavior: Balance Again chooses among best/equivalent results
odd attendance supports manually selected Shared Player
even attendance uses equal exclusive teams
offline failure does not clear setup
highLevelEngineBehavior: protects stronger batting/bowling distribution at a high level
privacyRules: Do not expose private pair/separation rules
Do not expose private hard constraints
Do not copy private balancing configuration into APK/public docs/UI/API responses/logs

apkV14Features: ADD LATE PLAYERS during active innings, including mid-over and first over
Shared Player may be newcomer or existing player
even current unique roster means no current Shared Player
odd current unique roster means exactly one current Shared Player
late arrivals receive no retroactive stats

apkSyncContract.explicitMatchDate: APK sends matchDate as YYYY-MM-DD; website uses it for current APK payloads and falls back safely for legacy payloads.
apkSyncContract.pomRecommendation: APK sends pomRecommendationPlayerId as recommendation only; website Admin remains authoritative.
apkSyncContract.rosterTransitions: Optional append-only roster transition snapshots allow active-match late players and changing Shared Player state by event boundary.
apkSyncContract.demoSafety: Demo Test Match can sync/review but cannot become official.

rules: validates deliveries against event-time roster snapshot
supports multiple different Shared Players over one match
any player Shared at any time receives no normal Win bonus
preserves one career match and one XP application
legacy APK payloads without rosterTransitions remain supported
websiteRosterTransitionSupport.liveScoringAuthority: Website is not needed during live APK scoring; APK handles the live game and website handles Pending Review/finalisation afterward.

pendingReview.rawPayloadRule: Preserve raw APK source payload separately from Admin working copy.
pendingReview.concurrency: review_version and review_is_stale prevent silent overwrite/finalisation of stale review copies.
pendingReview.finalisationSafety: Real imports require explicit official finalisation confirmation; Demo imports show cannot-finalise message and preserve server/RPC guards.

websiteFeatures: Best Batting Average / Current Run Banker

bestBattingAverage.qualification: minimum 5 batting innings and minimum 1 dismissal
bestBattingAverage.podium: existing #1 center, #2 left, #3 right podium retained

features: automatic persisted Match Stories after official finalisation

architecture: created only after successful official Admin finalisation
historicalReplay: baseline uses only earlier official finalised matches
same-day chronology uses official Game Number
later matches never affect earlier replay
missing legacy event-backed data remains unknown

rules: tracked-only advanced metrics compare valid tracked subsets
legacy missing data is not fabricated
no private Team Balance inputs used

players.rule: Never rename stable player IDs casually. Add players only to the canonical roster.

warnings: Do not run deferred migrations blindly
Do not use blanket supabase db push while manual migration history is unreconciled
Do not use service-role credentials in application code

architectureSafety: APK sync stops at Pending Review
Match Story finalisation behavior is non-blocking
